question: How many passenger trains are there as per 2021 data?
solution:
The correct answer is __**13169**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Indian railway runs **13,169** passenger trains daily, on both long-distance and suburban routes, covering **7,325 stations** across India.
 
• Mail or Express trains, the most common types of trains, run at an average speed of **50.6 km/h**.
 
• India has the fourth largest railway network with over** 22,593 **operating trains with a daily passenger count of** 24 million** passengers and **203.88 million** tonnes of freight.
 
• India's railway network is recognised as one of the **largest** railway systems in the world under single management.
 
• The passenger traffic in the railway sector dropped to around **1.3 billion** across India in fiscal year 2021. The significant decrease was mainly due to the impact of the coronavirus pandemic.
 
• Passenger rail traffic from India's suburbs was much higher than the non-suburban rail traffic at the end of fiscal year **2018**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Indian Railways

 
 
• **Indian Railways** is a statutory body under the ownership of Ministry of Railways, Government of India that operates India's national railway system.
 
• **Ashwini Vaishnaw** is the** current railway minister**.
 
• It manages the **fourth** largest national railway system in the world by size, with a total route length of 67,956 km as of** 31 March 2022**.
